description: This PHP class defines a controller named DeleteSavepointController within the OrangeHRM system's functional testing framework. It handles HTTP requests to delete specified savepoints by invoking a database backup service and returning the operation success status as a JSON response.

classes.name: DeleteSavepointController
classes.description: A controller class that handles deletion of savepoints during functional testing in OrangeHRM. It processes incoming HTTP requests, interacts with the database backup service, and returns the success status.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an HTTP request to delete specified savepoints and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.
